title: Red Hat Security Advisory: git-lfs security update
description: Red Hat has issued an important security update for git-lfs, addressing two vulnerabilities: a denial of service via excessive HTTP/2 SETTINGS frames (CVE-2026-78669) and man-in-the-middle attacks via untrusted intermediate certificates (CVE-2026-111943). These issues affect Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10.2 Extended Update Support and related variants. The update mitigates these security risks by patching the underlying components in git-lfs. Users are advised to apply the update as detailed in the Red Hat advisory.
